# Renata Alberigi

> Brazilian painter & visual artist. Brazilian painter and visual artist, born in Petrolina, Pernambuco, in 1993 and based in Caeté-Açu, in Bahia’s Chapada Diamantina. Self-taught, she has painted since childhood. Her practice focuses on hand-painted works in oil and acrylic, alongside portraits, installations and hand-drawn digital work.

English is the default language. Brazilian Portuguese is available at pt-br/. These documents describe the same portfolio shown to people; there are no additional credentials or private artwork records for agents.

Public portfolio preview for editorial review; not the final release.

Artwork titles and credited institutions retain their original names. A listed work is not automatically available for sale or licensed for reuse. This index neither authorizes training nor guarantees inclusion in search or any selection process.
